data.title: 罗丝薇瑟 · 深夜书房靛蓝真丝滑落的知性微醺
data.description: 深夜书房台灯昏黄，罗丝薇瑟身穿深靛蓝半透明真丝睡袍翻阅北欧古籍，睡袍半滑肩头，微醺泛红的脸庞流露毫无防备的温柔软弱。
data.action: 趴在堆满书籍的书桌上，睡袍滑落露出圆润香肩，指尖轻触空酒杯，微醺眼眸水汽氤氲
data.lighting: 复古黄铜台灯的暖黄光晕，勾勒柔和的肩颈锁骨弧线
data.camera: 近景微俯视角，聚焦知性气质与私密脆弱的交融
data.promptProse: Rossweisse slumps languidly over a cluttered mahogany desk in her private study late at night, surrounded by open leather-bound Norse tomes. Her sheer deep-indigo silk negligee slips effortlessly off one pale shoulder, revealing a glimpse of white lace beneath. With fingertips loosely touching the rim of an empty wine glass, her cheeks glow with a tipsy blush as her lavender eyes soften with vulnerable warmth.
data.animaCaption: Resting her cheek on the study desk as her indigo robe slips off one shoulder, Rossweisse blushes with sleepy, tipsy warmth.
